strongest_objection: The inference the map leads with, the loop from Salami back to Thirty-six before the first play in which 'the announced number and the paid piece are one mechanism seen from the two sides of the pay', conflates a cap with a target, and the Thirty-six item itself draws the line the loop erases: Polti's number 'forbids the thirty-seventh and the thirty-fifth alike' while the catalog's sixteen to eighteen is 'a work bound and not a target'. A cap answers a splitter by forbidding only the next piece; a target forces merges and splits in both directions and needs no splitter behind it, and Gozzi's thirty-six had none. Either the two are one mechanism, in which case the map carries one item at two positions and fails the distinct-mechanism standard, or they are two, in which case the loop closes only where a cap answers a split (the REF's four outputs) and never at Polti. The edge label and the form inference should say the second. A measurement sharpens the point against the author: of the eleven maps in the fleet directories, eight land on exactly eighteen items, which is the Thirty-six item's own tell ('a count that lands on the announced number in every retelling') firing on the catalog's declared work bound, so the bound behaves as a target and the map's own sixteen to eighteen is a case of its first item, not of its last. Secondary: the Head verb to Minimal pair edge asserts that no context separates the nine 'Pass to' items, which is false under the substitution test the edge invokes (swapping the dual for the ultraproduct changes every outcome); what lumps them is the roll of parts, and the label also contradicts itself ('upper bound' then 'never a count of members'). Two factual claims fail on count: somatic-atoms handles are not 'under three words each' (37 of 52 are three words), and the Roll of parts item attributes the eighteen to the roll when the count bound fixed it.

items.item: Thirty-six before the first play: the count is announced before the subject is read, and the enumerator splits or merges toward the announced number, so the unit becomes whatever divides the subject into that many; as Gozzi's claim, reported by Goethe to Eckermann in 1830, that there are only thirty-six tragic situations, which Schiller tried and failed to extend and which Polti in 1895 went looking for and found, exactly thirty-six, with lettered sub-situations under each absorbing whatever would have made thirty-seven; the same plays at other announced counts yield Booker's seven plots, Propp's thirty-one functions, and Cook's Plotto of 1928 with 1,462 conflicts, five catalogs of one subject whose units were set by five numbers and by no joint in the plays; the grain admits whatever partition lands on the number and forbids the thirty-seventh and the thirty-fifth alike; the tell of the wrong grain is that the last items are visibly a merge or a split made to land, a lettered sub-item, a final item that is two joined by 'or', or a count that lands on the announced number in every retelling; the counter-rule is this catalog's own, sixteen to eighteen as a work bound and not a target; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which asks a finished list to name its universe, the mechanism by which the count was fixed before the universe was; observed.
items.why: Only Polti's thirty-six (and arguably Booker's seven) was announced before the reading; Propp's thirty-one functions and Plotto's 1,462 were counted after it, and Propp's corpus is tales, not plays. 'Five catalogs whose units were set by five numbers' asserts the mechanism where the history shows a different fixer (the enumerator's stopping). The mechanism, the Gozzi-Goethe-Polti line, the lettered sub-situations, and the tells are all right and are kept.
items.repair: Thirty-six before the first play: the count is announced before the subject is read, and the enumerator splits or merges toward the announced number, so the unit becomes whatever divides the subject into that many; as Gozzi's claim, reported by Goethe to Eckermann in 1830, that there are only thirty-six tragic situations, which Schiller tried and failed to extend and which Polti in 1895 went looking for and found, exactly thirty-six, with lettered sub-situations under each absorbing whatever would have made thirty-seven; Booker's seven basic plots announce their number in the title, while Propp's thirty-one functions and Cook's Plotto of 1928 with 1,462 conflicts were counted after the reading, so one subject yields five catalogs at five counts, two of them with the unit set by a number announced first and three by where the enumerator stopped, which is a different fixer; the grain admits whatever partition lands on the number and forbids the thirty-seventh and the thirty-fifth alike; the tell of the wrong grain is that the last items are visibly a merge or a split made to land, a lettered sub-item, a final item that is two joined by 'or', or a count that lands on the announced number in every retelling; the counter-rule is this catalog's own, sixteen to eighteen as a work bound and not a target; adds to list-excellences' Denominator honesty, which asks a finished list to name its universe, the mechanism by which the count was fixed before the universe was; observed.

items.item: Rules before members: the unit is fixed by the rules of a world written down first, and an item is whatever those rules permit, so no member need have been found, as the chess problem, whose unit is a legal position with a stipulation, White to play and mate in two, that no game need ever have reached, the fairy piece defined by its move, the thought experiment, and this catalog's own invented-world lists, whose members are consistent thought-experiments under stated rules of embodiment and memory; the grain admits every position the rules allow and forbids the observed game's unit, the line that was played, which is the neighbouring grain at which the same board yields opening codes, five hundred of them from A00 to E99, each an attested line, rather than problems; the tell of the wrong grain inside the invented world is a member the rules forbid, the position that retrograde analysis shows no legal game could reach, which problem editors treat as a fault of the unit and not a curiosity; the tell of a mixed list is an invented item wearing an attested case, a made-up example dressed as a citation, so that the count adds found things to permitted things and means nothing; not the invented-world register's artifact, which is what a register manufactures; here the rules fix what one item is before any register writes it; observed.
items.why: A fixer distinct from every neighbour: the unit exists before any member does. The ECO count and the retrograde-analysis fault are correct and the tell is usable.

items.item: Head verb: a grammatical frame fixes the unit at one syntactic slot, phrased as a verb phrase, phrased as a noun phrase, and admits whatever can be conjugated into it and forbids what needs a clause; this catalog's mathematical-moves holds 128 verb phrases of which nine begin 'Pass to' (the dual, the complement, the completion, a dense subset, a sufficient statistic, and four more), eight 'Take the', seven 'Invoke the', seven 'Apply the', with 72 distinct head verbs in all, so at the frame's grain 'Pass to the dual' and 'Pass to the complement' are two items and at the grain of a mechanism with a carrier, a cost, and a tell they are one move, pass to a canonical associated object, with a list of objects hanging off it; the same subject at that neighbouring grain yields maps of eighteen; the tell of the wrong grain is a head that repeats while its object varies, and the number to read is distinct heads over items; adds to list-excellences' Parallel discipline, one frame carrying every item, the price the frame charges, that it fixes the unit at its slot and cannot see that two fillings of the slot are one move; observed, the counts being the catalog's own on the day of this fieldwork.
items.why: Counts verified against data/grown.jsonl on 2026-09-13: 128 items, nine 'Pass to', eight 'Take the', seven 'Invoke the', seven 'Apply the', 72 distinct first words. The tell (distinct heads over items) is countable without a critic, which no other item offers.

items.item: Two-slot name: the name form carries a fixed number of slots and the unit is whatever fills all of them, so adding a slot to the name refines the grain and removing one coarsens it, as the Linnaean binomial, where the species is what receives a genus and an epithet and the subspecies is what needs a third word, and this catalog's own pair, somatic-atoms, 52 items of under three words each ('The micro-nod', 'The gaze break'), beside somatic-signals, 72 items of which 53 take the form 'The [bodily state] of a [mental state]' ('The narrowed pupils of a search for hidden flaws'), so a signal is an atom with a second slot bolted on and one body yields 52 or 72 by the number of slots the name carries; the grain admits what can fill every slot and forbids what fills one, a bodily state with no mental reading is an atom and not a signal; the tell of the wrong grain is a slot that is always novel while the other repeats, which says the list is a list of the novel slot's fillings and the fixed slot is a costume, or a name that differs from its neighbour by one adjective; adds to somatic-atoms and somatic-signals the account of why they differ in count; not pricing-unit-metamorphoses' Assay eats the item, where a measured property replaces the thing; here a second name slot is added to it; observed.
items.why: Measured against data/grown.jsonl: somatic-atoms handles are two words in 14 cases, three in 37, four in 1, so 'under three words each' is false; and 50 of 72 signals match 'The X of a Y' by regex, so '53' is a hand count and should read 'about fifty'. The mechanism (slot count fixes the grain) and the binomial case are right. Note for the record: no bodily-state slot repeats across the 72 signals, so the item's tell does not fire on the catalog pair it cites; that is consistent (the tell is conditional) but the edge from this item should not imply it does.
items.repair: Two-slot name: the name form carries a fixed number of slots and the unit is whatever fills all of them, so adding a slot to the name refines the grain and removing one coarsens it, as the Linnaean binomial, where the species is what receives a genus and an epithet and the subspecies is what needs a third word, and this catalog's own pair, somatic-atoms, 52 items whose handles run two or three words ('The micro-nod', 'The head tilt'), beside somatic-signals, 72 items of which about fifty take the form 'The [bodily state] of a [mental state]' ('The narrowed pupils of a search for hidden flaws'), so a signal is an atom with a second slot bolted on and one body yields 52 or 72 by the number of slots the name carries; the grain admits what can fill every slot and forbids what fills one, a bodily state with no mental reading is an atom and not a signal; the tell of the wrong grain is a slot that is always novel while the other repeats, which says the list is a list of the novel slot's fillings and the fixed slot is a costume, or a name that differs from its neighbour by one adjective; adds to somatic-atoms and somatic-signals the account of why they differ in count; not pricing-unit-metamorphoses' Assay eats the item, where a measured property replaces the thing; here a second name slot is added to it; observed.

items.item: Roll of parts: the unit is fixed by a roll of parts every item must carry, a carrier, a cost, a tell, the condition lost, the last intervention, so a candidate with a part missing is not at this grain, and the roll converts themes into mechanisms or rejects them; the fleet briefs of this catalog fix each map's grain with a 'named with' clause, and the same subject without the roll splinters into cases, since each carrier of a mechanism becomes its own item once the mechanism no longer has to be named; the grain admits whatever has all the parts and forbids the tip, which has no tell, the theme, which has no carrier, and the example, which has no mechanism, which is why a territory that yields 128 verb phrases yields eighteen when each must carry parts; the tell of the wrong grain is a part filled the same way in most items, every tell 'you notice it later', every carrier 'the situation', which says the roll has one slot fewer than it claims, or a part filled by restating the item's own name; Zwicky's morphological box is the roll turned into a universe and belongs to the maps of manufactured denominators, since here the roll fixes what one is and not how many there are; observed.
items.why: 'A territory that yields 128 verb phrases yields eighteen when each must carry parts' credits the roll with a number the count bound fixed; the map's own first item names sixteen to eighteen as the catalog's bound, and eight of eleven fleet maps land on exactly eighteen regardless of their roll. The roll makes the territory yield fewer; it does not make it yield eighteen.
items.repair: Roll of parts: the unit is fixed by a roll of parts every item must carry, a carrier, a cost, a tell, the condition lost, the last intervention, so a candidate with a part missing is not at this grain, and the roll converts themes into mechanisms or rejects them; the fleet briefs of this catalog fix each map's grain with a 'named with' clause, and the same subject without the roll splinters into cases, since each carrier of a mechanism becomes its own item once the mechanism no longer has to be named; the grain admits whatever has all the parts and forbids the tip, which has no tell, the theme, which has no carrier, and the example, which has no mechanism, which is why a territory that yields 128 verb phrases yields far fewer when each must carry parts, though how many fewer is set by the count bound and not by the roll; the tell of the wrong grain is a part filled the same way in most items, every tell 'you notice it later', every carrier 'the situation', which says the roll has one slot fewer than it claims, or a part filled by restating the item's own name; Zwicky's morphological box is the roll turned into a universe and belongs to the maps of manufactured denominators, since here the roll fixes what one is and not how many there are; observed.

items.item: Measure word: the subject is a mass until a unit word is imposed, and the unit word chosen fixes what is being counted, as the classifier a Chinese count cannot omit, 一本书 a volume, 一套书 a set, 一册 one volume of a set, 一张纸 a sheet, so one shelf is one or twelve by the word, and the English mass noun needs the same imposition, a head of cattle, a grain of rice, a piece of advice; the grain admits whatever the word individuates and forbids the rest, so a set-word cannot see a volume and a volume-word cannot see the set; the same subject under the neighbouring classifier is the same subject with a different count and a different item; the tell of the wrong grain is a count with no unit word, eighty-five deal-flow sources are eighty-five what, channels, relationships, events, or introductions, and a list whose author cannot supply the classifier has not fixed its unit and cannot be told finer from coarser; adds to pricing-unit-metamorphoses, which walks the priced unit through its metamorphoses, the mechanism at the start of every one of them, that a thing is not for sale by the piece until a piece is declared; observed for the classifier cases, analytical for the claim that a count with no unit word is unfixed.
items.why: The 85-item list exists (deal-flow-sources, phrased as a noun phrase) and the 'eighty-five what' reading is fair. Modality split is declared honestly.

items.item: Chair, not furniture: the unit is fixed at the level where a picture arrives fastest and the most attributes are shared, chair and not furniture and not kitchen chair, which Rosch's experiments of 1976 found to be the level named first, learned first, and drawn as one outline, and Berlin found to be the folk genus in every language's names for plants and animals; the grain admits what can be drawn as a single shape and forbids the superordinate, which has no outline, and the subordinate, which is the basic item plus a modifier; the same subject at the expert's neighbouring grain sits one level down, the birder's unit is the species and the joiner's the wood, so the basic level moves with the reader's residence and a list has to say whose reader; the tell of the wrong grain is an item that needs an 'e.g.' before it can be pictured, too coarse, or an item told from its neighbour by an adjective alone, too fine; adds to list-excellences' Ostensive speed, a concrete instance arriving within three seconds, the mechanism that sets the grain where that speed peaks, and the warning that the speed is the reader's and not the subject's; observed for nouns of objects, analytical for lists of mechanisms, where no experiment has found a basic level.
items.why: Rosch 1976 and Berlin's folk genus are right; the expert shift (birder's unit one level down) is the documented Tanaka-and-Taylor effect. Modality split declared.

items.item: Binocular distance: the unit is fixed by what the reader's instrument resolves at working distance, so two things the instrument cannot separate are one item however distinct in hand, as the field guide, whose unit is the field mark told at binocular range and which therefore lumps the small flycatchers as 'Empidonax sp.' where the museum key, with the specimen in hand and the wing formula, separates them; and the epidemic case definition, where 'a case' is fixed by the available test, so that Hubei's count rose by nearly fifteen thousand on 12 February 2020 when clinically diagnosed cases from chest imaging were admitted to a count that had required a laboratory assay; the grain admits distinctions the reader can make in use and forbids those that need the specimen or the assay; the same subject at the neighbouring grain, the instrument one step better, yields more items and a step in the count on the day the instrument changed; the tell of the wrong grain is that step, a discontinuity in the series dated to a change of instrument and not of subject, or an item pair the intended reader cannot tell apart in use; adds to pricing-unit-metamorphoses' Nearest countable, where the priced unit retreats to what an accepted counter can inspect, the enumeration side of the same retreat; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form; here the traces exist and the question is what one is; observed.
items.why: Two cases, one fixer (the instrument at working distance). The Hubei step of 12 February 2020 is documented and is a tell readable from a time series alone, which is a genuine gain.

items.item: Minimal pair: the unit is fixed by a substitution test, two candidates are one item unless a context exists in which swapping them changes an outcome, as the phoneme, where /p/ and /b/ are two because 'pat' and 'bat' differ and aspirated [pʰ] and plain [p] are one in English because no English word turns on the difference, and two in Hindi and Thai because words do; the grain admits distinctions that do work somewhere and forbids variants however audible; the same sounds at the neighbouring grain, the phonetic transcription, yield hundreds of units where the phonemic yields about forty for English, and which count is right is a question about the language and not about the sounds; this catalog's sharpening check is the test made into a gate, take the two closest neighbours and show a case that separates them, and its separating case is the minimal pair; the tell of the wrong grain is an item pair for which no separating case can be written, which the test says to merge, or a separating case that is the item's own definition read twice; adds to list-excellences' Mutual exclusion, no item is another rephrased, the test that decides it; observed.
items.why: The phoneme case is exact and the aspiration contrast in Hindi and Thai is right. The item correctly names the catalog's own sharpening check as this test made into a gate.

items.item: One fix closes two: the unit is fixed by the repair, so two reports are one item if one change resolves both, as the bug tracker's 'duplicate of', the compiler that suppresses the forty errors a missing brace produces after the first and reports one, and the incident review that counts causes and not pages; the grain admits distinct causes and forbids symptoms, which are the neighbouring grain, the user's list, where the same subject yields one item per place it hurt; the tell of the wrong grain is readable only after a repair, when closing one item closes others, fixed by the same commit, resolved with the same change, and before the repair the tell is a critic's version of it, one objection that lands on two items at once says they are one; the grain is unusual in that it can be fixed only by running a repair or a criticism, so a list's count at this grain is provisional until one has been run; observed.
items.why: Distinct because it is the one fixer that cannot be run before a repair or a criticism, which makes the count provisional. That property separates it from Minimal pair, which the enumerator can run alone.

items.item: Travels alone: the unit is fixed by what the tradition copies on its own, so an item is whatever recurs outside any one parent, as Thompson's motif, 'the smallest element in a tale having a power to persist in tradition', indexed at about 46,000 beside the Aarne–Thompson tale type, the whole plot, indexed at about 2,400, two catalogs of one corpus at two grains, one asking which plots recur and one which pieces recur across plots; the grain admits elements found in more than one host and forbids the element bound to one plot, however striking, which is a feature of that plot and not a unit; the same corpus at the neighbouring grain above is the type, and at the grain below the motif is the detail no second tale carries; the tell of the wrong grain is an item that never appears outside one parent listed as if free, and its test is transport, try the item in a second domain and see whether it arrives; adds to list-excellences' Transposability, items surviving transport to distant domains, the fact that under this fixer transport is not a virtue of the item but the definition of the unit; observed.
items.why: Thompson's definition is quoted correctly; the motif/type pair is the cleanest same-corpus two-grain case in the map, and the transport test is usable.

items.item: Proton, not weight: the unit is fixed by an invariant chosen as identity, so two things are one item if they share it, as the element, which is what shares a proton count, so that 118 elements lump some 3,300 nuclides, and the same substances at the neighbouring grain, the isotope, are many items with their own weights and half-lives; Mendeleev ordered by atomic weight, a proxy that averages over isotopes, and had to place tellurium at 127.6 before iodine at 126.9, and later argon before potassium, against the weights, inversions that were faults of the grain-fixer and not of the table, and that vanished when Moseley's X-ray spectra of 1913 made the proton count readable and the unit's identity and its order agreed; the grain admits whatever shares the invariant and forbids distinctions the invariant does not see; the tell of the wrong grain is an inversion, a member that the order by the proxy puts on the wrong side of its neighbour, which says the identity the list is using is not the one it is ordering by; the empty cell is the other Mendeleev and belongs to the maps of what a form yields; here it is the inversion, and it says the unit's identity lies one instrument away; observed.
items.why: 'Faults of the grain-fixer and not of the table' is backwards: Mendeleev's unit (the element, by chemical identity) was right, and he placed tellurium before iodine on that identity against the weight; the fault was the ordering key, a proxy for the identity. The item's own tell ('the identity the list is using is not the one it is ordering by') already says this; the sentence before it should agree.
items.repair: Proton, not weight: the unit is fixed by an invariant chosen as identity, so two things are one item if they share it, as the element, which is what shares a proton count, so that 118 elements lump some 3,300 nuclides, and the same substances at the neighbouring grain, the isotope, are many items with their own weights and half-lives; Mendeleev ordered by atomic weight, a proxy that averages over isotopes, and had to place tellurium at 127.6 before iodine at 126.9, and later argon before potassium, against the weights, inversions that were faults of the ordering key and not of the unit, since Mendeleev placed tellurium before iodine on chemical identity and against the weight, and that vanished when Moseley's X-ray spectra of 1913 made the proton count readable and the unit's identity and its order agreed; the grain admits whatever shares the invariant and forbids distinctions the invariant does not see; the tell of the wrong grain is an inversion, a member that the order by the proxy puts on the wrong side of its neighbour, which says the identity the list is using is not the one it is ordering by; the empty cell is the other Mendeleev and belongs to the maps of what a form yields; here it is the inversion, and it says the unit's identity lies one instrument away; observed.

items.item: Merge on meeting: the unit is fixed by what the members do to each other where they meet, so two populations are one item if they merge on contact and two if they do not, as the biological species concept, under which the ring of Ensatina salamanders around California's Central Valley is one species along the ring and two where its ends meet, and the hypothetical-monopolist test of merger review, under which a market is the smallest set of products whose single owner could raise prices five percent without losing the sale, so products are one market if buyers cross between them at that price; the grain admits units the members separate for themselves and forbids the morph, the sex, the life stage, and the variant that merges freely; the same organisms at the neighbouring grain, the morphospecies, which is all a fossil can be, are counted by shape and split where shape differs; the tell of the wrong grain is a unit that is another unit's sex or stage, the eel larva named Leptocephalus brevirostris as its own genus until Grassi reared it into an eel in 1896, the deep-sea anglerfish male described as its own species before it was found fused to the female, and in the market case the cellophane fallacy, where the test run at a price a monopolist has already raised finds substitution everywhere and a market too wide, so the contact test fixes the wrong grain when run at the wrong price; observed.
items.why: Ensatina, the SSNIP test, the cellophane fallacy, Grassi 1896 and the ceratioid males all check. The two cases share one fixer (contact) and the wrong-price failure is a real tell.

items.item: Slip first: the unit exists only when a slip attests it, so the grain is fixed by the reading programme and not by the language, as the Oxford English Dictionary, whose senses are what quotation slips support and whose earliest citation dates the sense's birth, so a sense with no slip is not entered and a sense with one slip is a hapax; the grain admits the attested and forbids the possible, which is the neighbouring grain, where the same language yields Johnson's senses by analogy from the ones he had and a word's whole paradigm from its stem; the tell of the wrong grain is the ghost word, a unit the slip process manufactured, 'dord', entered in Webster's Second in 1934 from a slip reading 'D or d' for density, and the sense whose only attestation is another dictionary; the modality of a list is fixed here, since an observed item is one that has a slip and an item that cannot produce one must say it is speculative or invented, which is this catalog's rule of declared modality; not witness-architectures, which asks what must exist for a trace to form; here the trace is the definition of the unit; observed.
items.why: The OED and 'dord' cases are right and the item correctly makes the catalog's rule of declared modality a consequence of this fixer. The Johnson clause is the weakest case in the map (Johnson's Dictionary was itself quotation-built) but it is offered as the neighbouring grain, not as the mechanism, so it stands.

items.item: Household door: the unit is fixed by the container the counter visits, since the counter pays one visit per container and counts what the door yields, as the census, whose enumerator knocks on housing units and counts the persons attached to each under a usual-residence rule, so that a person attached to no door or to two, the couch-surfer, the child of two households, the person living in a vehicle, is counted zero or twice, and the undercount is a class and not a noise; the same population at the neighbouring grain, the register-based census of the Nordic states, is counted by person from population registers with no door at all, and the classes the door missed become the classes the register misses, the unregistered; the grain admits members attached to a countable container and forbids the unattached; the tell of the wrong grain is an error that has a demographic, since a random miss has none; in this catalog the door is the territory, so a fleet that enumerates by territory counts twice the mechanism that lives on the border of two, Mendeleev's table with a cell in one map and an inversion in another, and zero the one that lives in neither; adds to Measure word the case where the unit word is a container, which decides who cannot be counted; observed.
items.why: Usual-residence rule, the Nordic register census, and 'an error that has a demographic' are all correct; the fleet-by-territory double count is a fair reflexive case.

items.item: One hand's move: the unit is fixed by what the doer does in one move, since the doer is charged one move per item, so an item is one act by one hand, as the aviation checklist, one challenge and one response per line, the recipe step, the commit that carries one logical change, and the control handoff that passes one aircraft on one frequency; the grain admits acts that one hand completes and forbids the phase, before takeoff, which is the neighbouring grain above, and the muscle motion, which is the grain below; the tell of the wrong grain is an item the doer must split to do, which reads 'and then', or an item done as a side effect of another, which the doer ticks without acting, and both are visible in the doer's hands and not on the page; a list at this grain is as long as the work and cannot be shortened by lumping without hiding a move, so its count is not the enumerator's to set; not Chair, not furniture, where the reader's picture fixes the unit; here the reader's act does, and a thing pictured at once may take three moves; observed.
items.why: The checklist, recipe step, and single-change commit are one fixer, and the tell 'and then' is readable in the doer's hands. Distinct from Chair by the item's own argument (a thing pictured at once may take three moves).

items.item: One occurrence or two: the unit is fixed by a rule that carries a price per unit, and where the rule is ambiguous a third party construes it, so the count is argued by the parties who gain from a finer or a coarser grain and fixed by whoever rules, as the allowable unit of prosecution, under which Bell v. United States in 1955 held that driving two women across a state line in one trip was one offence and not two, by the rule of lenity, which coarsens whenever the statute does not say; and the per-occurrence limit, under which the attack on the World Trade Center was tried as one occurrence at $3.5 billion or two at $7 billion, and the jury found one under one insurer's form and two under another's, since the forms defined the unit in different words; the grain admits whatever the rule's construction yields and forbids the natural unit; the same acts at the neighbouring grain, per victim, per day, per building, are the counts each side pleaded; the tell of the wrong grain is that the count changes with who is counting, so a list whose count moves with the counter's interest has its grain fixed here and by none of the fixers before it; adds to pricing-unit-metamorphoses, whose units are agreed between a buyer and a seller, the unit neither agreed and a third fixed; observed.
items.why: Bell v. United States (1955) and the World Trade Center occurrence trial are correctly stated, and the tell (a count that moves with the counter's interest) is the only tell in the map that names who benefits.

items.item: Salami: the counted party is paid per unit, so it fixes the grain itself by splitting, and the unit drifts finer for as long as the pay runs, as the least publishable unit, one study cut into the most papers a referee will pass, the vulnerability filed as several advisories, the story split into tickets to move a burndown, and the lettered sub-situations that let a count of thirty-six hold more; the grain admits whatever a piece can be paid as and forbids nothing, which is why no hand fixes it; the same work at the neighbouring grain, the study, is what the counter wanted to count; the tell of the wrong grain is items that share method, data, and author and differ by one variable, and the counter's reply is a count bound, at most four outputs per researcher in the British research assessments, which makes the party lump back toward the bound; in this catalog the grower is paid in kept items and the judge's grain is its own, so a climbed list may be as fine as its judge was lenient, and the tell would be a head that repeats; observed for the publishing and filing cases, speculative for the catalog case, which the measurement of head verbs would settle.
items.why: The LPU, the split advisory, and the REF's four-output cap are right; the catalog clause is marked speculative and names the measurement that would settle it. 'Forbids nothing, which is why no hand fixes it' sits oddly beside 'it fixes the grain itself', but the sense (no hand but the paid one) is recoverable.

neighbor_test.separating_case: Both are name forms fixing the unit, and they share a tell (one slot repeats while the other varies). They separate on what they admit and forbid: Head verb fixes the unit by syntactic category and forbids what needs a clause; Two-slot name fixes it by arity and forbids what fills fewer slots. The case: somatic-atoms handles ('The head tilt') are a noun-phrase frame with one content slot, fixed by Head verb's mechanism (a clause like 'the head tilts when the listener doubts' is refused) and untouched by Two-slot's (there is no second slot to fill); somatic-signals ('The narrowed pupils of a search for hidden flaws') are fixed by arity, and a bodily state with no mental reading is refused, while the frame category is unchanged. One body, one frame category, two arities, 52 or 72. The pair holds; the shared tell is acceptable because Head verb's version is a ratio one can count (distinct heads over items) and Two-slot's is a pair test (neighbours that differ in one slot).

boundary_case: The embedding neighbour: the catalog's dedup threshold under which two candidates closer than a cosine cutoff are one item. It tempts as its own fixer (a machine's hand, neither the enumerator's nor the reader's) but rules as a case of Binocular distance with the embedder as the instrument, and it carries that item's tell exactly: a step in the count on the day the embedding model changes and nothing in the subject did. Not a new member. A second tempting nonmember, the seriation axis, is out because an order takes units as given and belongs to the fleet's map of what a form yields.

edges.why: The antecedent's illustration is wrong: the nine 'Pass to' items are separated by context under the substitution test the edge invokes (a problem where duality helps is not one where the ultraproduct does), so the test does not lump them; the roll of parts does. The label also says 'upper bound' and then 'never a count of members', which contradict: if every adjacent pair separates, the frame's count is the member count.
edges.repair_label: If a frame admits two fillings that no context separates, then the substitution test lumps them and the frame's count is an upper bound on the test's, so a list phrased in one frame has not fixed its unit until a separating case has been asked of each adjacent pair; the nine 'Pass to' items are not this case, since swapping the dual for the ultraproduct changes every outcome, and what would lump them into one move is a roll of parts, not the substitution.

edges.repair_label: If a name form adds a slot to a frame, then fillings the frame held as one item are now several by the added slot, one body yields 52 atoms or 72 signals, so adding a slot refines the count without touching the head, and the tell that the slot manufactured the distinction is that the fixed slot repeats across the new slot's fillings, a tell the somatic pair does not show, since no bodily state repeats among the 72.

edges.why: A real conditional: the antecedent (two items identical in every part but the case) can fail, and when it holds the consequence (one repair closes both) is the cheapest prediction in the map. The corollary that an always-identical part is not a part is sharp and correct.

The passage between levels is real: the identity grain is reachable only when the instrument reads the invariant, and pre-Moseley inversions are the tell. Antecedent fails once the spectra exist, which is exactly what the label says.

The handover holds and has an observed case the author did not need: species status under an endangered-species listing is argued by parties with a stake precisely where the hybrid zone leaves the contact test partial (the red wolf). The antecedent (a partial answer) can fail, and when it fails the grain stays the subject's.

Conflates a cap with a target; the Thirty-six item itself distinguishes them ('forbids the thirty-seventh and the thirty-fifth alike' versus 'a work bound and not a target'). modality_problems: Thirty-six before the first play: Propp's thirty-one and Plotto's 1,462 are presented as counts announced in advance; they were found after the reading, and Propp's corpus is tales, not plays. Repaired above.

Roll of parts: the eighteen is attributed to the roll; it is the count bound's. Repaired above.

Slip first: 'Johnson's senses by analogy from the ones he had' is the weakest case in the map, since Johnson's Dictionary was itself quotation-built; left standing because it is offered as the neighbouring grain and not as the mechanism.

No physical or technical jargon disguises an unsupported mechanism; every item closes with a declared modality, and the three split modalities (Chair, Measure word, Salami) are declared where they occur.
best_unresolved_seed: Cap versus target as two fixers, not one: a cap ('at most N') fixes the unit by forcing lumps only and leaves the count free below it; a target ('exactly N', or a range every list lands at the top of) forces lumps and splits both ways and fixes the unit as whatever divides the subject into N. The catalog's sixteen-to-eighteen is declared a cap and behaves as a target (eight of eleven fleet maps at exactly eighteen; none at sixteen); the question is whether the maps that landed on eighteen carry the Thirty-six tell (a last item that is two joined by 'or', a sub-item absorbing what would have been the nineteenth), which a read of the eighteenth item of each would settle in an hour, and whether a bound stated as 'at most' with no floor produces a different distribution.
independent_review_line: Fable critic: admitted after repairing four items whose cases outran their history or their counts (Polti's five catalogs, the somatic word counts, the roll's eighteen, Mendeleev's culprit) and three edge labels, the closing loop being reduced from one mechanism seen twice to a cap answering a split, with the measured finding that eight of eleven fleet maps land on exactly eighteen.
